scope: Current Expert Mission skill acquisition index
purpose: Provide one stable reverse index from canonical skill identity to documented Expert Mission acquisition evidence without asserting guaranteed drops or numerical rates.
nonclaims: The index does not assert that an indexed skill is guaranteed on every clear.
The index does not contain numerical drop rates.
The index does not imply that a mission is the only possible acquisition route.
Raid-only or Crystal-Raid-only rewards are not silently merged into ordinary Expert Mission reward records.
Historical mission numbering is not substituted for the repository's current EM01-20 numbering.
next_research: Verify canonical skill identity presence and category for all 18 records against skills.json.
Reconcile first-clear versus repeat acquisition where evidence exists.
Separate ordinary mission skill drops from raid-linked skills.
Expand acquisition indexing beyond Expert Missions into Parallel Quests, mentors, shops, raids, tournaments, and other systems.
